scientific_integrity: The exact identities and monotonicity proof establish the quantified theorem; sampled checks are supplemental, and the rational witness is exact. Underlying Hassell and Beverton-Holt models are prior work. No empirical or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic positive scalar Hassell recurrence; shared positive equilibrium and exponent. Multi-season scramble sorting applies to initial populations below the equilibrium and to strengths with a(p-1)K<=1. The three-season counterexample refutes universal sorting above that boundary; it does not classify every permutation or long-term dynamic behavior. Scientific priority is provisional pending broader historical comparison.
title: Sharp seasonal sorting boundary and three-season reversal for common-equilibrium Hassell recruitment
